title: Numbers to 20: Count, Name and Order
seo_title: Foundation Numbers to 20 Worksheets: Counting, Ten-Frames and Ordering (Free, with Answers)
standard_text: Name, represent and order numbers including zero to at least 20, using physical and virtual materials and numerals.
meta_desc: Free Foundation (Prep, Kindergarten) maths worksheets on numbers to 20, matched to the Australian Curriculum (AC9MFN01): count things, zero, teen numbers on ten-frames, before and after, and ordering. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Count each thing once. The last number you say is how many.
key_sub: Zero means none. A full ten-frame is 10, so 14 is 10 and 4 more.
body_html:
Count each thing once

Touch each thing and say one number. The last number you say tells how many.

Zero means none

An empty plate has 0 things on it. Zero is a number too.

Numbers 11 to 20

A full ten-frame is 10. Teen numbers are 10 and some more.

Before and after

Count on one to find the number after. Count back one to find the number before. Numbers that come later when we count are bigger.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do
Counting a thing twice or missing oneTouch or move each thing as you count
Writing 21 for twelveTeen numbers start with the 1: 12 is 10 and 2
Thinking zero is not a number0 is the number for none
Mixing up before and afterBefore: count back. After: count on

faq.q: What numbers do Foundation students learn in maths?
faq.a: In the Australian Curriculum (AC9MFN01), Foundation students name, represent and order numbers from 0 to at least 20. They count things, read and write numerals and say which number comes before or after.

faq.q: Is Foundation the same as Prep or Kindergarten?
faq.a: Yes. Foundation is the first year of school. It is called Kindergarten in NSW and the ACT, Prep in Queensland, Victoria and Tasmania, Pre-primary in WA, Reception in SA and Transition in the NT.

faq.q: Why does my child write 21 for twelve?
faq.a: We say the teen numbers backwards (four-teen sounds like 4 then 10). Show 12 on two ten-frames: one full ten and 2 more, so the 1 is written first.

faq.q: How can I practise counting at home?
faq.a: Count steps, pegs, grapes or toy cars, touching each one. Ask: How many? What number comes next? What comes before?
